#   ⟨62⟩ adaption-air_bench_healthcare_es 
This dataset contains document identifiers for the Spanish healthcare question answering task from the AIR-Bench 24.05 benchmark. The samples consist of unique document IDs (e.g., doc-920273) likely serving as ground truth retrievals or candidates for the default development and test splits. It is designed to evaluate information retrieval systems within the medical domain.
###   ⟨53⟩ Dataset size 
There are 28,043 data points in this dataset. This is an instruction tuning dataset.
